latestMilestone: System Edition now ships verified native GTK4 foundations for SWIR Software Center and SWIR Update Center. Software Center provides bounded installed-package inventory and literal local APT-cache search. Update Center provides a bounded, non-destructive apt-get simulation using locally available metadata. Both remain unprivileged and expose no install/remove/apply/repository-refresh controls; privileged mutation stays behind the existing journaled SWIR package transaction and Polkit boundaries. The exact integration head passed all six triggered workflows, including native Wayland runtime, graphical-session UEFI, Live USB install and full graphical-installer E2E. Roadmap remains 51/65 (78.5%) because the full native daily-use application suite and physical Live USB qualification are still open.
